item.title: How to persist Vuex state
item.description: Persisting Vuex state ensures your application maintains user data and preferences across browser sessions and page reloads. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve implemented state persistence in numerous Vue.js enterprise applications. The most reliable approach uses the vuex-persistedstate plugin combined with localStorage for automatic state hydration and persistence. This method provides seamless user experience while maintaining application performance.
